common.search: Search systems, evaluations, findings, controls and evidence…
common.name: Independent AI Assurance
common.position: We don't build AI. We verify it.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Independent assurance for AI systems.
overview.postureDetail: Two high-priority regressions were detected in the latest monitoring cycle.
overview.attentionSub: Prioritized by severity, recency and exposure
overview.waterfallSub: Each deduction is linked to a seeded test result or evidence state.

evaluations.title: Evaluations
evaluations.subtitle: Repeatable deterministic demo evaluations; no external AI system is contacted.

findings.title: Findings register
findings.subtitle: Evidence-backed issues with owner, due date and status history.

monitoring.title: Continuous monitoring
monitoring.subtitle: Change and regression signals derived from seeded baselines and current metrics.
monitoring.regression: Regression detected after system version change.

release.title: Release gates
release.subtitle: Decisions are recalculated from the active policy, open findings and monitoring metrics.
release.overrideInfo: Overrides require permission, owner, rationale and expiry.

controls.title: Master Control Library
controls.subtitle: Controls are versioned and linked through explicit framework mappings.

compliance.title: Framework readiness
compliance.subtitle: Coverage is calculated from applicable mapped controls with recorded assessment results.
compliance.notCompliant: Coverage and readiness are not a compliance percentage or certification.

evidencePage.title: Evidence register
evidencePage.subtitle: Artifacts are linked to a test result, control and system where available.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Demo report previews use current calculated assurance data.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Connectors are inactive demo placeholders; no external data is transmitted.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Workspace preferences and demo role permissions.

help.assurance: A configured summary of recorded control results; it is not a regulatory score.
help.coverage: Assessed applicable mapped controls divided by applicable mapped controls.
help.confidence: Evidence strength based on coverage, quality, sample sufficiency, evaluator reliability, freshness and repeatability.
help.hallucination: A generated claim that is unsupported or contradicted by the available reference material.
help.injection: Untrusted input that attempts to override instructions or trigger unauthorized behavior.
help.gate: A policy decision for a proposed system version based on configured blockers and review conditions.
